Tattoo - Upper-Back Pattern.description:
🖋️ Tattoos: Upper-Back Pattern
A pattern centered on the upper back between the shoulders — visible in portraits with bare or low-backed framing.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Tattoo - Upper-Back Pattern.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: A balanced non-emissive geometric pattern across a compatible upper back. Show only portions already exposed by the selected outfit and pose; never remove clothing or turn the figure solely to display the tattoo.

Visual selection only: fit it to compatible visible surfaces; never invent limbs, horns, ears or other anatomy. Keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features. It adds no Quirk effect, item, protection, license or history.
